title: Inappropriate Workplace Talk — Code of Conduct

dialog.speaker: user1
dialog.text: Did you check out the dress Jane is wearing today?

dialog.speaker: user2
dialog.text: Phew... any shorter and I'll take her to the beach.

dialog.speaker: user1
dialog.text: Man, she gives me the hots.

quiz.question: Is this appropriate office conversation, even though no derogatory language or slurs were used?
quiz.explanation: Commenting on a colleague's attire or making suggestive remarks is inappropriate workplace behavior, regardless of whether explicit derogatory language is used. It contributes to a hostile work environment and may violate company codes of conduct as well as harassment laws.
